environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The Flask app listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP/443 -> TCP/8080. No application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. SQLite database at /var/data/inventory.db contains product catalog and api_keys table. API keys are distributed to integration partners.
